steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Spread out!
The words have barely left your mouth before the creature launches itself forward, its body propelled like a cannonball tearing free of its barrel.
[Vibration Effect]
It plows headfirst through a half-collapsed stone pillar, debris exploding across the ground. The group scatters in an instant, barely clearing the impact zone.
Letta's lamppost comes crashing down against its flank, the blow ringing out like a strike against thick metal plating. The creature is knocked slightly off course, but it does not stop.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Wow! It's seriously tough. Tougher than the diamonds in my family's collection even!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Now is so not the time to admire it!
The coin bank gouges a deep furrow into the ground as it grinds to a halt, its gaze snapping toward Murphy at the rear with unnerving intensity.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: Aaah! It's looking right at me! It totally thinks I'm the easy target!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: This is bad. I can't find a single weak spot!

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: Um... okay, since it's a coin bank, maybe its weakness is its center of gravity? Or...the usual spots on small animals? You know, like the ears, or under the arms...?
EMP swiftly maneuvers to flank it, loosing arrow after arrow at its ears, yet just as before, each shot fell agonizingly short.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Tch. Something's seriously wrong here...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Letta, take out its legs! Sweep low with the lamppost!
Letta answers, heaving the weighty lamppost up and ramming it into the ground. With a powerful twist, she sweeps it horizontal, forging a low barricade right across the center of the passage.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Round things always trip over stuff like this!
18 [Coin bank cries out - select a voice line from the coin bank's audio files]
The coin bank screeches, kicks off the ground, and barrels toward your group. Its front legs snag the lamppost right on cue, sending the whole thing hurtling through the air.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: It worked?!
But a split second later, it ricochets back using its own momentum, crashing into the lamppost with enough force to rip it clean out of Letta's grip.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: That... that doesn't even make sense!
The coin bank skids in place, its gleaming golden eyes swiveling with calculating intent. Then it launches itself skyward, poised to come crashing down and flatten everything beneath it.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: No!!!
In that instant, the roar in Murphy's ears stretches into an endless, distorted drone.
(Flashback)

steps.speaker: Vague Voice
steps.content: Ugh... Why does this kind of thing always happen when you're around...

steps.speaker: Vague Voice
steps.content: Seriously. We barely ever get to hang out like this, and now... ugh. Way to kill the mood.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>...Can we still hang out? After this?</color>

steps.speaker: Vague Voice
steps.content: Just forget it. Nothing good ever happens when you're here.

steps.speaker: Vague Voice
steps.content: Forget it... Being around you just means bad luck. My mom told me to stay away from you.

steps.speaker: Vague Voice
steps.content: Murphy... let's just call it off. What if you end up getting the other students hurt?

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>Get them... hurt...?</color>

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>No... They'll get hurt! I can't let that happen again!</color>
(Back to present)

She takes in the sight before her: Letta standing firm in her defense, EMP still loosing arrows without relent, Lynn running back and forth to pull the monster's attention away... and ${PlayerName}, who has never once given up on her.
They haven't shoved her aside. They haven't muttered a word about her cursed luck. Even at the most dangerous moment, they keep her sheltered behind them.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: We grow the finest wheat in all of WhiteSands, but the moment we signed that deal, we lost all say in the price! Every industry we try to build, we have to kneel and ask the metropoles for permission!

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: I finally have people who treat me like a <color=#fb9259>friend</color> again... and I am NOT letting you hurt them!
You are just about to release your shackles when Murphy dashes forward, swift as an arrow flung from the bowstring.
Meow!
The moment it registers a new enemy, the rotund coin bank wheels around and comes rolling straight for Murphy.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: Even if it means burning up all my luck for the next twenty years. No, wait, what luck do I even have?! Fine! Then I'll stake every bit of bad luck from my entire life!

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: Take this—
She has barely taken two steps before her left foot snags her right, sending her pitching forward into the ditch without so much as finishing her sentence.
But the fall saves her. The charging coin bank lost its mark in an instant.
Meooooow!!
And so, the very next second, right before everyone's eyes, it barrels past the ditch and crashes headlong into the shattered stone wall ahead with a thunderous boom.

With a series of earth-shaking rumbles, the coin bank, along with the broken rubble, tumbles into the deeper darkness below. The clattering din of its fall echoes downward, growing fainter and farther, until finally—clang—it lodges somewhere unknown.
The entire passage falls abruptly still. Only the patter of loose stones continues to fall. Murphy, covered in dust and dirt, pokes half her head out of the ditch.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: ...Did I actually, you know... help?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: In a way, yeah.

Just then, a piercing shriek of static splits the air above them. Crzzzt—bzzt—crzzzt— The noise erupts without the slightest warning, like a transmission signal forcing its way through, clawing desperately across some other layer of warped space.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: Huh...? What's that sound?

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Sounds... kind of like...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>The Bureau's broadcast?</color>
The next second, a halting yet deeply familiar voice squeezes its way out of the noise.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: ...Chief... if you can hear this... please respond...

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Repeat... if you can hear this... please respond...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Nightingale?
